title: Goodhart Stress-Test: Reward Overoptimization as Proxy-Target Divergence

original_idea.body:
# Goodhart Stress-Test

**Problem:** Practitioners lack a cheap way to detect onset of RM-true-quality decoupling.

**Direction:** Best-of-N against an open RM with increasing N, track RM score vs an independent judge, identify the Goodhart breakpoint. No RL.

**Why it matters:** A single reproducible number for when a reward proxy fails.

**Relevant context:** NeurIPS 2024 scaling laws; arXiv:2604.13602.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Operationalizes reward overoptimization, a core alignment failure; a reproducible breakpoint is independently valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Best-of-N sampling plus a judge, no RL; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: defined N grid, breakpoint metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open RMs, no RL infra; independent-friendly diagnostic.

low_compute.reasoning: Best-of-N inference, no training; one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: BoN reward overoptimization / Goodhart curves are well studied.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: BoN overoptimization curves are well established.
